name: El Puente
reviewOutcome: State cadastral custodian and official property-information procedures evidenced; no public parcel service qualified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: English and Spanish first-party discovery queries were executed and recorded in the city record. Official IRCNL pages, the SGC endpoint, and the official visor link were inspected. The SGC showed a login wall; the visor returned an application error; no public viewer configuration, schema/CRS, or bounded anonymous ID+geometry response was available.
localRegistryEvidence: IRCNL is the evidenced state registral/cadastral custodian. Its official page documents Ubicación y/o Información de Predios and directs users to a mediated portal workflow. The evidence does not establish a municipality-specific public parcel API for El Puente.
scopeLimits: No GeoJSON sample retained because no safe native parcel ID plus unchanged native geometry was obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested.
Exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point, map-extent, or citywide absence conclusion was drawn.
Packet completion does not mean source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The public state systems may require a mediated workflow or may expose services not discoverable from the observed pages. The failed anonymous routes cannot establish citywide coverage or absence.
runtimeAdmission: held pending independent serial qualification of a real adapter and public ID+geometry service.
